propositions: All structured-output consumers must route through a single PydanticAIRunner facade with one authoritative bounded-operation path, eliminating bespoke retry schedulers and manual retry machinery.

The structured_retry_limit knob caps the output-retry allowance N, which seeds both the in-Agent output retries budget and the constructed UsageLimits request addend, guaranteeing the request budget cannot trip before output-repair retries.

A well-formed first structured response executes exactly one outer agent.run_sync call; a second call only occurs on the bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade; bespoke fresh-Agent output-attempt loops are eliminated.
The structured_retry_limit=0 knob preserves the single-shot fail-safe (zero output-repair retries and zero allowance addend), maintaining abstain batch semantics in overlap/judge.py and contracts.py.

All in-tree structured consumers (plan_review, code_review, overlap/judge, enrich, epic_bug_screen, evals, workflow, scripts) are verified to use the facade via mode-resolving AST census, not literal grep.
